import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a count plot of dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.countplot(data=data, y='Rasse1Text', order=data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().index, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a count plot of dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.countplot(data=data, y='Rasse1Text', order=data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().index, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
